title: Signal SCP Boundary After Post-Hoc Irreversibility
decision: Introduce an explicit DMP to SCP interface to signal when decisions cross into non-bypassable ethical or identity-related risk.
context: Some decisions become irreversible in practice and begin affecting trust, autonomy, or identity. Continuing without constraints becomes unsafe.
rationale: Systems must not silently proceed once human-centric boundaries are crossed.
consequences: Boundary crossings are explicit and traceable without enforcing control.
scp_risk_notes: Observed irreversibility combined with autonomy impact requires SCP constraint awareness before further action.
